lines.en: I inch forward on my jet of water.

lines.zh: 直锥形的壳拖在身后，很沉。
lines.en: The straight cone shell drags heavy behind me.

lines.zh: 我浮在中层水里，缓缓移动。
lines.en: I drift at mid depth, moving slowly.
I rise a little toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，壳也慢慢转过来。
lines.en: I turn, and the long shell follows.

lines.zh: 我用触手拨水，调整方向。
lines.en: My tentacles stir the water to steer.
I glide along the sea floor.
I drift over the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我松开一点浮力，往下沉。
lines.en: I let off some buoyancy and sink.
I rise toward the light.

lines.zh: 我把触手收拢，减小阻力。
lines.en: I draw my tentacles in to cut drag.

lines.zh: 我又喷了一下，往前一段。
lines.en: Another pulse of water and I go a stretch.
I go around a patch of weed.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流走，省些力气。
lines.en: I ride the current to save effort.

lines.zh: 我把歪掉的壳一点点扭回来。
lines.en: I twist my tilted shell back to plumb.
I settle deeper.

lines.zh: 我把壳里的气放掉一点，往下沉。
lines.en: I vent a little gas and settle down.
I swim along the reef edge.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，触手轻轻摆。
lines.en: I hang in the water, tentacles swaying.
I am slowly adjusting the gas in my shell.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有水在动。
lines.en: I do not move; only the water does.
Small fish circle around me.
I spread my tentacles and close them.
Light breaks into strips in the water.
I sink an inch.
I rest the shell's tip on the seabed.
I listen to the sounds in the water.
I wait for the current to move.

lines.zh: 我的触手尖有一个卷起来。
lines.en: One tentacle tip curls up.

lines.zh: 我飘着，连触手都懒得动。
lines.en: I drift, too idle to stir a tentacle.
I coil my tentacles slowly.

lines.zh: 水流过壳口，发出很轻的声。
lines.en: Water passes my shell's mouth with a soft sound.

lines.zh: 我把触手转过去，对着你。
lines.en: I turn my tentacles toward you.

lines.zh: 你踩在干岸上，我够不着。
lines.en: You keep to dry land, out of my reach.
I float up a little.

lines.zh: 水面的影子比我小得多。
lines.en: Your reflection on the surface is far smaller than me.

lines.zh: 你在水里的时候，我才会靠近。
lines.en: Only when you are in the water do I come near.
I reach a tentacle out and touch the water.
You move and the surface ripples.
I judge how far you are from the water.
I right my shell and drift slowly.

lines.zh: 我只是看着，没有别的意思。
lines.en: I am only looking; nothing more.
A pale split opens in my shell wall.
The knock spins me several turns.
A hard jet of water carries me back.

lines.zh: 所有触手一下全缩进壳口。
lines.en: Every tentacle snaps back into the aperture.
I sink and press to the sea floor.
Some gas has leaked from my shell.
I steady slowly, shell still askew.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进来，触手摸不着方向。
lines.en: Silt floods in and my tentacles lose the way.
I keep that in my shell seams.
I can still float.
I do not touch that sort.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢进水里，我没动。
lines.en: You toss it into the water and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我伸触手碰了一下，又收回。
lines.en: I touch it with a tentacle and withdraw.
That is not my food.
I drift a circle around it.
I drift toward the darker water.

lines.zh: 你在岸上用这个引不动我。
lines.en: That will not draw me from the shore.
I want nothing.
I push it off to one side.
I drift away slowly.

lines.zh: 一撞之下，我整只横了过来。
lines.en: The hit turns me broadside.
My shell hits stone with a dull knock.
I steady slowly, my shell still rocking.
My tentacles pull in to guard.
I drift a distance away.
This shell is heavy and will not shift.
I sink a little to avoid it.
The water clouds with silt.
I float back to my old depth.
I right my shell slowly.

lines.zh: 我们只是同类，各自漂着。
lines.en: We are only the same kind, drifting apart.

lines.zh: 我把触手伸出去，又收回。
lines.en: I reach out a tentacle and draw it back.

lines.zh: 我绕着它慢慢转了一圈。
lines.en: I drift one slow circle around it.
Our shells touch with a light knock.
It sinks and I sink with it.
We do not come very close.
It drifted off and I did not follow.
The water separates us.
I go on toward the deep.
This water is wide enough for both.
One tentacle hooks it.
I bring it to my beak.
It is too hard for my beak.
My tentacles loosen and let it sink.
I hold it and turn it slowly.

lines.zh: 送到喙边，什么味也没有。
lines.en: At my beak, it tastes of nothing.
I pin it against the shell.
I taste a little.
I let go and it sinks.
I drift on.
Something is stirring in the water.
I spread all my tentacles.

lines.zh: 那边游动的影子我盯上了。
lines.en: I have marked the shadow moving there.
I slowly right my shell.
I rise a little toward it.
I am estimating its range.
The water carries it closer.
I settle low, ready to jet.
It has not noticed me.
I wait for the current to help.
I track its movement.
It goes left and my tentacles follow.
I hold to its flank.

lines.zh: 它再近半身，触手就够到。
lines.en: Half a body closer and my tentacles reach.
My tentacles reach out slowly.
When it moves, I adjust.
The light in the water helps me.
It is beginning to panic.
At this range I can already reach.

lines.zh: 这些礁缝，我闭着眼也认得。
lines.en: I know these crevices blind.

lines.zh: 我把触手甩出去缠住它。
lines.en: I lash my tentacles out and coil around it.
I drag it down with me.
My beak bites down, hard.
That one held.
It tears free and I coil again.
I drive my shell's tip like a spear.
I drag it a full turn.
It retreats and I let go.
The water is thick with silt.
Tentacles released, I sink back into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从深水里浮上来，壳先出现。
lines.en: I rise from the deep, shell first.

lines.zh: 直锥形的壳在光里发白。
lines.en: The straight cone glows white in the light.
I adjust my buoyancy slowly.
This sea is shallower than I remember.
I open my tentacles one by one.
The fish all withdraw.
I settle toward the sea floor.
Sand slides off my shell.
I set a new heading.
The water echoes inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我朝着有礁石的地方去。
lines.en: I head for the rocks.
Shell tip down, I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 热隔着水传过来，我的触手缩紧。
lines.en: Heat comes through the water and my tentacles clench.

lines.zh: 我从水里掉下去，壳磕在石上。
lines.en: I drop through the water and my shell strikes stone.
Water floods my shell and my buoyancy fails.

lines.zh: 炸响在水里散开，我整只翻了过来。
lines.en: The blast spreads through the water and flips me over.

lines.zh: 有东西打穿了壳，我朝深处沉。
lines.en: Something pierces my shell and I sink for the deep.

lines.zh: 一股冷意在水里绕住我。
lines.en: Cold force coils around me in the water.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到东西，我漂得发虚。
lines.en: Too long unfed and my drifting grows weak.

lines.zh: 雷沿着水传上来，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning travels up the water and I lock up.

lines.zh: 没有水也没有地，我一直往下。
lines.en: No water and no ground, and I fall on.
